{"path": "neuron_growth_openrouter-deepseek-deepseek-v4.1-flash_01.html", "edit_description": "Create a complete, self-contained single-file HTML neon neuron-growth network simulator.

STRUCTURE / BOILERPLATE:
- <!DOCTYPE html>, <html lang="en">, <head> with <meta charset="utf-8">, viewport meta, <title>Neural Growth Field</title>.
- CSS: html,body full height, margin 0, background #05070f, dark; body uses flexbox to center content. A wrapper div holds the 800x800 canvas plus the dat.gui container. Canvas: width=800 height=800 attributes, border-radius 6px, box-shadow using rgba(0,229,255,0.08) and #101a3a glow, display block. Add a small caption line under the canvas using color #ffd400, monospace, letter-spacing, opacity ~0.7. Style .dg (dat.gui) minimally: monospace font, and do NOT fight dat.gui's default dark theme (it is already dark); optionally set .dg.main background to #05070f and text color #ffd400 for accents via a couple of CSS rules.
- Scripts at end of body: <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/dat-gui/0.7.9/dat.gui.min.js"></script> then the inline <script> with the simulation. dat.gui is the ONLY external library. No other libs, no images, no textures, no fonts.

PALETTE (use these exact hex values as defaults):
background #05070f, background glow #101a3a, main branch #00e5ff, accent branch #d6ff00, synapse #ff2bd6, pulse #fff36a, UI accent #ffd400, grid/scanline rgba(0,229,255,0.08).
Do NOT mention any game, movie, brand, franchise, or copyrighted visual style anywhere in code or comments. Keep comments neutral and technical.

SETUP:
- const canvas = document.getElementById('scene'); const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d'); const W=800,H=800.
- Global state: neurons[], branches[], synapses[], pulses[], plus flags growing, paused, frame counter.
- params object holding all GUI values (see GUI section) with sensible defaults.
- resize/DPR: keep it simple — canvas is fixed 800x800 backing store; no scaling needed.

GUI SETUP (dat.gui):
- const gui = new dat.GUI({ width: 300 });
- Folder "Growth": Neuron Count (3..6, step 1, default 4), Growth Speed (0.2..4, default 1.4), Max Depth (1..9, step 1, default 5), Split Chance (0..0.5, default 0.12), Curvature (0..1, default 0.45), Max Branch Length (10..90, default 42).
- Folder "Synapses": Synapse Distance (6..60, default 22), Synapse Glow (0..40, default 18).
- Folder "Pulses": Pulse Speed (0.1..3, default 1), Pulse Frequency (0..2, default 0.5), Pulse Brightness (0.2..2.5, default 1.2).
- Folder "Visuals": Background Color (#05070f), Branch Color (#00e5ff), Accent Branch Color (#d6ff00), Synapse Color (#ff2bd6), Pulse Color (#fff36a). (Use addColor with string defaults.)
- Add three buttons (place them near the top level or in a folder named "Actions"): "regenerate network" -> regenerate(), "clear canvas" -> clearCanvas(), "pause / resume" -> togglePause(). Buttons must call the functions.
- All GUI changes that affect structure should take effect on next regenerate; color/speed changes should apply live.

NEURON GROWTH (animated step-by-step, not instant):
- regenerate(): clear arrays; pick n = Math.round(params.neuronCount) clamped 3..6; place seeds at random positions within a radius ~90px of canvas center (400,400) using polar coords so they are near the center but spread out.
- Each neuron object: {x, y, tips:[...], depth:0, id}. Each tip/branch object: {x, y, px, py (previous point for curve), angle, depth, len, width, maxLen, neuronId, parentId, alive, growth (0..1 progress), target length}.
- Growth loop: every frame while growing and not paused, advance each active branch tip by params.growthSpeed * a few pixels along its angle. Use a target segment length; when the tip reaches its target length, spawn child branches: always continue one branch (unless depth >= maxDepth) and with probability params.splitChance spawn 1-2 side branches with smaller width and length. Side branches are "smaller side branches".
- Direction: angle += random walk scaled by params.curvature (e.g. (Math.random()-0.5) * 0.35 * curvature). Add slight bias away from center for organic spread. Clamp total branch count to ~600 and depth to params.maxDepth.
- Store each branch as a short polyline of points (push a point every few px) so rendering can draw smooth quadratic curves through them. Width = base * (1 - depth/maxDepth) with small random variation (e.g. * (0.8 + Math.random()*0.4)), min ~0.6.
- Growth ends when no branch is alive/expanding -> growing=false, then pulses keep animating.

SYNAPSE DETECTION:
- Every few frames, compare branch TIPS (endpoints) pairwise; if distance < params.synapseDistance and the two tips belong to DIFFERENT neurons (or different branch ids), create a synapse.
- Prevent duplicates: key = min(idA,idB)+'_'+max(idA,idB); keep a Set of used keys.
- Synapse object: {ax, ay, bx, by, a: branchIdA, b: branchIdB, phase: random, strength: 0.5..1}. Cap total synapses (~120).

PULSE ANIMATION:
- Spawn pulses over time based on params.pulseFrequency: each frame, with small probability (params.pulseFrequency * 0.05) create a pulse on a random synapse: {syn, t:0, dir: random 0/1, speed: params.pulseSpeed * (0.4..0.8)}.
- Update: t += speed * dt-ish increment; interpolate position along the synapse segment (lerp) — smooth movement. When t>=1, remove pulse (or ping-pong). Keep pulses array small (cap ~60).
- Pulses are short electric sparks: draw a small bright dot with strong shadowBlur plus a short trailing line.

RENDERING (requestAnimationFrame):
- Clear with background color each frame (fillRect). Optionally draw a radial background glow using #101a3a at low alpha behind everything.
- Draw a faint grid + scanlines using rgba(0,229,255,0.08): vertical/horizontal grid lines every ~40px and horizontal scanlines every 3-4px at very low alpha; optionally add subtle animated noise by shifting scanline offset with frame counter.
- Branches: ctx.lineCap='round'; for each branch stroke a path built from its points using quadraticCurveTo midpoints for smooth organic curves. Main branches use params.branchColor; branches with depth>=2 or flagged accent use params.accentBranchColor. Use ctx.shadowBlur = small (6-10) and shadowColor = branch color for neon glow. Line width from branch.width.
- Synapses: draw a soft glowing line between the two points with params.synapseColor, shadowBlur = params.synapseGlow, alpha pulsing with sin(time + phase) so they breathe. Synapses glow brighter than branches.
- Pulses: draw with params.pulseColor, shadowBlur ~ 20 * params.pulseBrightness, globalAlpha scaled by params.pulseBrightness.
- Vignette: after drawing, overlay a radial gradient from transparent center to dark edges (createRadialGradient) with rgba(5,7,15,0..0.85) to darken corners. This is canvas-only, no images.
- Reset ctx.shadowBlur=0 and globalAlpha=1 at the end of each frame.
- Use a single rAF loop; when paused, still render (or skip updates) but do not advance simulation. Keep it lightweight: no particle systems, no physics, no pathfinding.

HELPERS: clearCanvas() fills the canvas with the background color and resets shadow state (does not destroy the network unless documented — it clears the visible canvas; simplest: it clears drawn frame and also clears arrays if you prefer; choose: clearCanvas clears the canvas pixels only and keeps network, and regenerate() rebuilds the network). togglePause() flips `paused` and updates the button label if practical.

Keep the code compact, well-commented with short section headers: // --- setup ---, // --- GUI setup ---, // --- neuron growth ---, // --- synapse detection ---, // --- pulse animation ---, // --- rendering ---, // --- main loop ---. Everything must be valid, runnable vanilla JS with no syntax errors."}
